Mavlink.SendVideo_comment: 1: send the video stream (Parameters_Video.json); 0: MAVLink only, no Pi needed
Mavlink.Source_comment: File (a .tlog, looped), UDP (datagrams to UdpPort on this PC) or Serial
Mavlink.TlogFile_comment: File source: a .tlog, relative to the project folder or absolute
Mavlink.UdpPort_comment: UDP source: port on this PC the MAVLink datagrams are sent to (e.g. by mavlink-router)
Mavlink.SerialPort_comment: Serial source: the flight controller's telemetry port (needs pyserial)
Mavlink.SerialBaud_comment: Serial source: baud rate (ArduPilot telemetry ports: 57600 by default)
Mavlink.MaxBlocksPerPacket_comment: most transport blocks of a packet given to MAVLink (it goes before the video)
Mavlink.MaxAge_ms_comment: MAVLink frames waiting longer than this are dropped
Mavlink.LoopbackForward_comment: loopback only: host:port the received frames are sent to (a ground station)
Mavlink.LoopbackSaveTlog_comment: loopback only: 1 saves the received frames to App/Mavlink/Loopback_Received.tlog
